text_block_list.text:
Crossing the finish line of the Tenno Sho 
(Autumn), a race she ran alongside 
everyone's dreams, Ines Fujin was smiling, 
having enjoyed the race from the bottom of 
her heart.

Ines Fujin will hesitate no longer. From 
now on, she will run joyfully for her own 
sake. And everyone's cheers will surely 
become her driving fuel.

For the next race, I want to choose one 
where Ines Fujin can have the most fun. 
Where she'll run next is――

We decided to set our sights on the Japan 
Cup, where Umamusume from around the world 
gather. Time to get preparations underway 
with Ines Fujin.
Target race changed to Arima Kinen.

The Arima Kinen, drawing the attention of 
countless race fans, is a fitting goal. 
It's time to make preparations with Ines 
Fujin.
